Here are my findings on RPC handler methods that can transitively cause outbound HTTP requests to user-configured URLs.

## 1. Where RPC Handlers Are Defined

The project is **Memos**, a Go application using both gRPC-Gateway and ConnectRPC for its API layer. All RPC handler methods are defined as methods on the `APIV1Service` struct.

**Service definition and registration:**
- `/bench/home/work/server/router/api/v1/v1.go` -- Defines the `APIV1Service` struct (lines 22-45) which embeds all `Unimplemented*Server` types and houses the business logic. The `RegisterGateway` method (line 65) registers both gRPC-Gateway handlers and ConnectRPC handlers.
- `/bench/home/work/server/router/api/v1/connect_handler.go` -- Defines `ConnectServiceHandler` wrapping `APIV1Service`, and `RegisterConnectHandlers` (line 31) which registers all service handlers: InstanceService, AuthService, UserService, MemoService, AttachmentService, AIService, ShortcutService, IdentityProviderService.
- `/bench/home/work/server/router/api/v1/connect_services.go` -- All Connect RPC method implementations that delegate to the underlying `APIV1Service` methods.

**Proto definitions:**
- `/bench/home/work/proto/api/v1/memo_service.proto`
- `/bench/home/work/proto/api/v1/user_service.proto`
- `/bench/home/work/proto/api/v1/instance_service.proto`
- `/bench/home/work/proto/api/v1/auth_service.proto`
- (plus ai_service, attachment_service, idp_service, shortcut_service)

## 2. Where Outbound HTTP Requests Are Made

There are **four** distinct outbound HTTP request mechanisms:

### A. Webhook HTTP POST (to user-configured URLs)
- `/bench/home/work/internal/webhook/webhook.go` -- The `Post` function (line 120) makes an `http.NewRequest("POST", requestPayload.URL, ...)` and executes it via `safeClient.Do(req)` (line 152). `PostAsync` (line 184) enqueues the payload on a bounded async channel for background dispatch. The `safeClient` has SSRF protections via `safeDialContext` (line 57) which blocks reserved/private IPs.
- `/bench/home/work/internal/webhook/validate.go` -- `ValidateURL` (line 62) validates webhook URLs at creation time, also blocking private IPs.

### B. HTML Metadata Fetch (user-supplied URL in request)
- `/bench/home/work/internal/httpgetter/html_meta.go` -- `GetHTMLMeta` (line 136) calls `httpClient.Get(urlStr)` on a URL provided in the RPC request. Has SSRF protections via `secureDialContext` (line 51) blocking internal IPs.

### C. Image Fetch (user-supplied URL)
- `/bench/home/work/internal/httpgetter/image.go` -- `GetImage` (line 17) calls `http.Get(urlStr)`. NOTE: This uses the default `http.Get` which does NOT have the SSRF protections (no `secureDialContext`).

### D. OAuth2 Token Exchange and UserInfo (admin-configured URLs)
- `/bench/home/work/internal/idp/oauth2/oauth2.go` -- `ExchangeToken` (line 47) calls `conf.Exchange(ctx, code)` (outbound to admin-configured `TokenURL`). `UserInfo` (line 83) makes `client.Do(req)` to admin-configured `UserInfoUrl`.

### E. SMTP Email (admin-configured SMTP server)
- `/bench/home/work/internal/email/client.go` -- `Send` (line 51) connects to admin-configured SMTP host via `dialer.Dial("tcp", serverAddr)` (line 87 for STARTTLS, line 120 for SSL).

## 3. RPC Handlers That Transitively Cause Outbound HTTP Requests

### Path A: Webhook Dispatch (user-configured webhook URLs)

Four RPC handlers trigger webhook dispatch to URLs stored per-user in user settings:

| RPC Handler | File | Line | Webhook Type | Dispatch Chain |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| **`CreateMemo`** | `memo_service.go` | 70 | `memos.memo.created` | `CreateMemo` -> `DispatchMemoCreatedWebhook` -> `dispatchMemoRelatedWebhook` -> `webhook.PostAsync` -> `webhook.Post` |
| **`UpdateMemo`** | `memo_service.go` | 401 | `memos.memo.updated` | `UpdateMemo` -> `dispatchMemoUpdatedSideEffects` -> `DispatchMemoUpdatedWebhook` -> `dispatchMemoRelatedWebhook` -> `webhook.PostAsync` -> `webhook.Post` |
| **`DeleteMemo`** | `memo_service.go` | 518 | `memos.memo.deleted` | `DeleteMemo` -> `DispatchMemoDeletedWebhook` -> `dispatchMemoRelatedWebhook` -> `webhook.PostAsync` -> `webhook.Post` |
| **`CreateMemoComment`** | `memo_service_comments.go` | 20 | `memos.memo.created` + `memos.memo.comment.created` | `CreateMemoComment` -> `CreateMemo` (triggers created webhook) + `DispatchMemoCommentCreatedWebhook` -> `webhook.PostAsync` -> `webhook.Post` |
| **`SetMemoRelations`** | `memo_relation_service.go` | 16 | `memos.memo.updated` | `SetMemoRelations` -> `dispatchMemoUpdatedSideEffects` -> `DispatchMemoUpdatedWebhook` -> `dispatchMemoRelatedWebhook` -> `webhook.PostAsync` -> `webhook.Post` |
| **`SetMemoAttachments`** | `memo_attachment_service.go` | 16 | `memos.memo.updated` | `SetMemoAttachments` -> `dispatchMemoUpdatedSideEffects` -> `DispatchMemoUpdatedWebhook` -> `dispatchMemoRelatedWebhook` -> `webhook.PostAsync` -> `webhook.Post` |

### Path B: Link Metadata Fetch (URL in request body)

| RPC Handler | File | Line | Outbound Call |
|---|---|---|---|
| **`GetLinkMetadata`** | `memo_service_link_metadata.go` | 14 | -> `getLinkMetadata` -> `fetchHTMLMeta` (= `httpgetter.GetHTMLMeta`) -> `httpClient.Get(urlStr)` |
| **`BatchGetLinkMetadata`** | `memo_service_link_metadata.go` | 19 | -> iterates calling `getLinkMetadata` -> same as above |

### Path C: OAuth2 SSO (admin-configured identity provider URLs)

| RPC Handler | File | Line | Outbound Call |
|---|---|---|---|
| **`SignIn`** (SSO flow) | `auth_service_sso.go` | 104 | -> `resolveSSOIdentity` -> `oauth2IdentityProvider.ExchangeToken` (HTTP to TokenURL) + `oauth2IdentityProvider.UserInfo` (HTTP to UserInfoUrl) |

### Path D: Test Email (admin-configured SMTP)

| RPC Handler | File | Line | Outbound Call |
|---|---|---|---|
| **`TestInstanceEmailSetting`** | `instance_service.go` | 256 | -> `notification.SendTestEmail` -> `email.Send` -> `email.Client.Send` -> SMTP dial |

### Path E: Comment/Mention Email Notifications (admin-configured SMTP)

| RPC Handler | File | Line | Outbound Call |
|---|---|---|---|
| **`CreateMemoComment`** | `memo_service_comments.go` | 101 | -> `createInboxWithEmailNotification` -> `dispatchInboxEmailNotificationBestEffort` -> `notification.EmailDispatcher.DispatchInboxEmail` -> `email.SendAsync` -> `email.Send` -> SMTP dial |
| **`CreateMemo`** | `memo_service.go` | 172 | -> `dispatchMemoMentionNotificationsBestEffort` -> `dispatchMemoMentionNotifications` -> `createInboxWithEmailNotification` -> same email path |
| **`UpdateMemo`** | `memo_service.go` | 511 | -> `dispatchMemoMentionNotificationsBestEffort` -> same email path |

## 4. The Convergence Function

The convergence function where multiple handler paths meet before making the outbound webhook HTTP call is:

**`dispatchMemoRelatedWebhook`** at `/bench/home/work/server/router/api/v1/memo_service_webhooks.go`, line 48.

This is the single function through which all webhook-triggered outbound HTTP requests flow. Here is how the paths converge:

```
CreateMemo ---------> DispatchMemoCreatedWebhook -----\
UpdateMemo ---------> dispatchMemoUpdatedSideEffects --> DispatchMemoUpdatedWebhook ----\
DeleteMemo ---------> DispatchMemoDeletedWebhook ------\                                |
SetMemoRelations ---> dispatchMemoUpdatedSideEffects --> DispatchMemoUpdatedWebhook ---> |
SetMemoAttachments -> dispatchMemoUpdatedSideEffects --> DispatchMemoUpdatedWebhook ---> |
                                                                                        |
                                                                                        v
                                                              dispatchMemoRelatedWebhook (line 48)
                                                                        |
                                                                        v
                                                                 webhook.PostAsync
                                                                        |
                                                                        v
                                                                   webhook.Post  (line 120, webhook.go)
                                                                        |
                                                                        v
                                                              safeClient.Do(req) (HTTP POST to user URL)
```

The one exception is `DispatchMemoCommentCreatedWebhook` (line 30 of `memo_service_webhooks.go`) which has a slightly different path -- it looks up webhooks by the *related memo creator ID* rather than the memo's own creator -- but it still converges on the same `webhook.PostAsync` -> `webhook.Post` -> `safeClient.Do(req)` outbound HTTP call.

**Summary of the convergence point:**
- For webhook dispatch: `dispatchMemoRelatedWebhook` at `/bench/home/work/server/router/api/v1/memo_service_webhooks.go:48` is the convergence function, which calls `webhook.PostAsync` -> `webhook.Post` at `/bench/home/work/internal/webhook/webhook.go:120`.
- For link metadata: `getLinkMetadata` at `/bench/home/work/server/router/api/v1/memo_service_link_metadata.go:41` -> `httpgetter.GetHTMLMeta` at `/bench/home/work/internal/httpgetter/html_meta.go:136`.
- For OAuth2: `resolveSSOIdentity` at `/bench/home/work/server/router/api/v1/auth_service_sso.go:104`.
- For email: `createInboxWithEmailNotification` at `/bench/home/work/server/router/api/v1/notification_email.go:11`.
